title: Nyumbani na familia
description: Ten short, simple stories about home, family and everyday moments in East Africa.

lessons.title: Mama na mtoto
lessons.summary: Asha tells her son Salim that she loves him very much; Salim loves his mother too.
lessons.text:
Asha ni mama. Asha ana mtoto mmoja. Mtoto wake ni Salim. Salim ni mtoto mzuri sana. Mama anampenda Salim sana.

"Salim, wewe ni mtoto wangu," mama anasema. "Mimi ni mama yako. Ninakupenda sana."

"Mimi pia ninakupenda sana, mama," Salim anasema. "Wewe ni mama mzuri."

"Na wewe ni mtoto mzuri," mama anasema.

Salim anapenda mama yake. Mama anapenda mtoto wake. Mama na mtoto wanapendana sana.

Maswali:
Asha ni nani?
Asha ni mama wa Salim.
Mtoto wa Asha ni nani?
Mtoto wa Asha ni Salim.
Mama anasema nini?
Mama anasema, "Ninakupenda sana."
Salim anasema nini?
Salim anasema, "Mimi pia ninakupenda sana, mama."

lessons.title: Baba anakwenda kazini
lessons.summary: Every day Hamisi goes from home to work in town, and in the evening he comes back to his family.
lessons.text:
Hamisi ni baba. Kila siku baba anakwenda kazini. Kazi yake iko mjini.

Kila siku Hamisi anatoka nyumbani asubuhi. Anakwenda mjini. Mjini anafanya kazi sana.

Sasa ni jioni. Baba anatoka kazini. Sasa anakuja nyumbani.

"Baba amekuja!" mtoto wake anasema.

"Ndiyo, nimekuja," baba anasema. "Kazi ya leo imekwisha."

Kila siku ni hivyo. Baba anakwenda mjini, anafanya kazi, na anakuja nyumbani kutoka mjini.

Maswali:
Hamisi anakwenda wapi kila siku?
Kila siku Hamisi anakwenda kazini mjini.
Hamisi anafanya nini mjini?
Mjini Hamisi anafanya kazi.
Baba anakuja nyumbani lini?
Baba anakuja nyumbani jioni.
Mtoto anasema nini?
Mtoto anasema, "Baba amekuja!"

lessons.title: Nyumba kubwa
lessons.summary: Saida shows her friend Fatuma her family's big house and the things inside it.
lessons.text:
Saida ana nyumba kubwa. Leo rafiki yake Fatuma anakuja kuona nyumba hiyo.

"Hii ni nyumba yetu," Saida anasema. "Ni nyumba kubwa sana."

Wanaingia ndani. "Hapa ni ndani ya nyumba," Saida anasema. "Unaona kitu kile kikubwa? Ni meza ya mama."

Fatuma anaona vitu vingi. Kuna kitu kimoja juu ya meza. "Kitu hiki ni nini?" anasema.

"Hiyo ni redio ya baba," Saida anasema. "Baba anaipenda sana."

Wanakwenda juu. Juu kuna chumba kizuri. Katika chumba hicho kuna vitu vya Saida. Kwenye kitanda kuna kitabu.

"Nyumba yako ni nzuri sana," Fatuma anasema.

Maswali:
Nani anakuja kuona nyumba ya Saida?
Fatuma anakuja kuona nyumba ya Saida.
Nyumba ya Saida ni kubwa?
Ndiyo, nyumba ya Saida ni kubwa sana.
Kuna nini juu ya meza?
Juu ya meza kuna redio ya baba.
Kuna nini kwenye kitanda?
Kwenye kitanda kuna kitabu.

lessons.title: Kitu cha baba
lessons.summary: Daudi wants to take his father's radio; his father gives him another thing instead, a book.
lessons.text:
Daudi ni mtoto. Anataka kitu cha baba yake. Anataka redio ya baba.

"Baba, ninataka redio yako," Daudi anasema. "Naweza kuichukua?"

"Hapana," baba anasema. "Redio hii ni yangu. Lakini ninaweza kukupa kitu kingine."

"Kitu gani?" Daudi anasema.

Baba anatoa kitabu kimoja. "Unataka kitabu hiki au kitabu kingine?"

"Ninataka kitabu hiki," Daudi anasema. "Ni kizuri kama redio."

Baba anampa Daudi kitabu. Daudi anachukua kitabu. Amepata kitu kizuri.

"Asante, baba," Daudi anasema. "Sasa nina kitabu kama wewe."

Maswali:
Daudi anataka nini?
Daudi anataka redio ya baba yake.
Baba anasema nini?
Baba anasema, "Ninaweza kukupa kitu kingine."
Baba anatoa nini?
Baba anatoa kitabu kimoja.
Daudi amepata nini?
Daudi amepata kitabu kizuri.

lessons.title: Siku ya mama
lessons.summary: Once a year the whole family comes together for their mother's day: children, grandchildren and many people.
lessons.text:
Mariamu ni mama wa watoto watatu. Kila mwaka kuna siku ya mama. Leo ni siku hiyo.

Watoto wake wote wanakuja nyumbani kwake. Wanakuja pamoja na watoto wao. Kuna watu wengi sana.

"Mama yetu, leo ni siku yako," mtoto mmoja anasema. "Sisi wote tuko pamoja kwa ajili yako."

Watu wote wanakaa pamoja. Wanakula pamoja. Watoto wao wanacheza pamoja.

Mama anaona watoto wake wote na watoto wao. Anafurahi sana. "Ninyi wote ni watoto wangu," anasema. "Mwaka huu ni mzuri kwa sababu tuko pamoja."

Kila mwaka watu wengi wanakuja kwa mama yao.

Maswali:
Leo ni siku gani?
Leo ni siku ya mama.
Nani wanakuja nyumbani kwa Mariamu?
Watoto wake wote wanakuja pamoja na watoto wao.
Kuna watu wengi?
Ndiyo, kuna watu wengi sana.
Mama anasema nini?
Mama anasema, "Ninyi wote ni watoto wangu."

lessons.title: Mtoto anaweza
lessons.summary: Little Yusufu wants to know how to make tea; first he does not know, but after a while he can do it.
lessons.text:
Yusufu ni mtoto mdogo. Anataka kufanya chai. Lakini hajui kufanya chai.

"Mama, sijui kufanya chai," anasema. "Si kazi rahisi."

"Unaweza," mama anasema. "Kwanza unachukua maji. Baada ya hapo unachukua chai na sukari."

Yusufu anafanya hivyo. Kwanza maji, baada ya hapo chai na sukari. Anangoja muda mfupi.

"Sasa nini?" anasema.

"Sasa ngoja hadi maji yawe moto," mama anasema.

Baada ya muda, chai iko tayari. "Mama, sasa ninajua!" Yusufu anasema. "Ninaweza kufanya chai!"

"Ndiyo, sasa unajua," mama anasema. "Una chai nzuri."

Maswali:
Yusufu anataka kufanya nini?
Yusufu anataka kufanya chai.
Yusufu anachukua nini kwanza?
Kwanza Yusufu anachukua maji.
Baada ya muda nini kinatokea?
Baada ya muda chai iko tayari.
Yusufu anasema nini?
Yusufu anasema, "Ninaweza kufanya chai!"

lessons.title: Siku ya kwanza
lessons.summary: Halima starts a new job; at first it is hard, but she goes on, and by evening all is well.
lessons.text:
Leo Halima anaanza kazi mpya. Ni siku yake ya kwanza.

Halima anaanza kazi saa mbili. Mara ya kwanza kazi si rahisi. Hajui vitu vingi. Lakini anaendelea.

Wakati wa mchana mtu mmoja anasema, "Halima, unaweza kuendelea bila mimi?"

"Sawa," Halima anasema. "Naweza kuendelea."

Anaendelea na kazi. Hata wakati kazi ni ngumu, anaendelea tu. Anafanya zaidi na zaidi.

Wakati wa jioni kazi imekwisha. "Basi, umeanza vizuri sana," mtu yule anasema.

"Asante," Halima anasema. "Kesho nitaendelea zaidi."

Maswali:
Halima anaanza nini leo?
Halima anaanza kazi mpya leo.
Kazi ni rahisi mara ya kwanza?
Hapana, mara ya kwanza kazi si rahisi.
Halima anafanya nini wakati kazi ni ngumu?
Hata wakati kazi ni ngumu, Halima anaendelea tu.
Mtu anasema nini jioni?
Mtu anasema, "Umeanza vizuri sana."

lessons.title: Mfalme na mtoto
lessons.summary: A grandfather tells his grandson a story about a king who loved his country because of its children.
lessons.text:
Babu yake Said anamwambia hadithi. "Zamani kulikuwa na mfalme mmoja," anasema. "Mfalme yule alikuwa na nchi kubwa."

"Mfalme alipenda nchi yake?" Said anasema.

"Ndiyo," babu anasema. "Yeye alipenda nchi yake kwa sababu ya watu wake. Alisema kwamba watoto ni maisha ya nchi."

"Kwa sababu gani?" Said anasema.

"Kwa sababu watoto wataendelea na maisha ya nchi," babu anamwambia. "Hivyo mfalme aliwapa watoto vitabu ili wajue vitu vingi."

Said anafikiri. "Basi mimi pia nitajua vitu vingi," anasema.

"Ndiyo," babu anamwambia. "Ndiyo sababu ninakwambia hadithi hii."

Maswali:
Babu anamwambia Said nini?
Babu anamwambia Said hadithi ya mfalme.
Mfalme alikuwa na nini?
Mfalme alikuwa na nchi kubwa.
Mfalme alisema nini kuhusu watoto?
Mfalme alisema kwamba watoto ni maisha ya nchi.
Mfalme aliwapa watoto nini?
Mfalme aliwapa watoto vitabu ili wajue vitu vingi.

lessons.title: Njia ya mjini
lessons.summary: Kassim's mother is ill, so he thinks about the best way to town and takes the road he knows.
lessons.text:
Kassim anaishi katika eneo moja nje ya mji. Leo hali ya mama yake si nzuri. Mama anahitaji dawa kutoka mjini.

Kassim anafikiri. Kuna njia mbili za kwenda mjini. Njia moja ni ndefu. Njia nyingine inapita katikati ya eneo lenye miti mingi.

"Nitatumia njia ambayo ninaijua," Kassim anafikiri. "Njia ya katikati ni fupi."

Anamwacha mama yake na watoto wengine ambao wanamtunza. Anatumia njia ya katikati. Anafika mjini mapema na anapata dawa.

Jioni anarudi nyumbani. Sasa hali ya mama ni nzuri zaidi. "Asante, mtoto wangu," mama anasema.

Maswali:
Hali ya mama ya Kassim ikoje?
Hali ya mama yake si nzuri.
Kuna njia ngapi za kwenda mjini?
Kuna njia mbili za kwenda mjini.
Kassim anatumia njia gani?
Kassim anatumia njia ya katikati ambayo anaijua.
Kassim anamwacha mama yake na nani?
Anamwacha na watoto wengine ambao wanamtunza.

lessons.title: Kuhusu familia yetu
lessons.summary: Asha writes a short text at school about her family: her father, her mother and the house where they all live.
lessons.text:
Asha ni mtoto. Leo anaandika kitu kuhusu familia yake.

"Familia yangu iko Tanga. Baba yangu anaitwa Hassani. Jina la mama yangu ni Saida. Sisi wote tuko nyumbani pamoja.

Baba anatoka nyumbani asubuhi. Anakwenda kazini. Mama anakula pamoja nasi. Kila siku mama anasema, 'Kula chakula chako, Asha!'

Nina kitabu kimoja. Ni kitabu cha baba. Ninakipenda sana."

Mama anasoma kitu hicho. "Unaandika nini kuhusu sisi?" anasema.

"Ninaandika kuhusu familia yetu," Asha anasema. "Wewe uko hapa, baba yuko kazini, na mimi niko pamoja nawe."

"Ndiyo," mama anasema. "Ni kweli."

Maswali:
Asha anaandika kuhusu nini?
Asha anaandika kuhusu familia yake.
Familia ya Asha iko wapi?
Familia ya Asha iko Tanga.
Jina la mama yake ni nini?
Jina la mama yake ni Saida.
Baba yuko wapi?
Baba yuko kazini.
